summary:
Lead Engineer at Cypress.io. Before that, about seven years as a principal consultant at Object Partners / Improving, and five years at Lockheed Martin doing Java and REST services in the defense sector. MS Software Engineering (Penn State), BS Computer Engineering (Iowa State).

Most of my career has been full-stack TypeScript and JavaScript — React and Vue on the front end, Node on the back end. I've shipped production work in finance, healthcare, defense, e-commerce, and QA. Consulting clients included Mutual of Omaha, TD Ameritrade (now Schwab), Chewy, WoodmenLife, and the US Air Force. Earlier roles were heavy on Java, Spring Boot, and Angular.

Recent focus has been on enabling agentic workflows — Agent Skills, an MCP server and CLI for working with Cypress Cloud data, LLM-oriented docs, and runtime hooks . UI Coverage records the DOM across every moment of a test run, analyzes interactive elements in each state, and flags what your tests never touched. That stack involved Puppeteer, ClickHouse, and a fair amount of AWS (SQS, ECS, Lambda, S3).

For AI/LLM work I care about the boring parts that actually ship: prompt design, evals, tracing, and observability (Langfuse), across Claude, Gemini, Bedrock, and Vertex, with local models via Ollama when it makes sense. Day-to-day backend is GraphQL and REST over PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and ClickHouse. Testing side is Cypress, Playwright, Jest, and Vitest. Production monitoring with Honeycomb and Sentry.

I lead projects and small teams — mostly aligning stakeholders on technical direction, mentoring, and keeping delivery predictable. Open-source contributor and community support are part of the job at Cypress, not a side hobby.

AI / LLM: Agentic workflows, MCP, and LLM-powered product features Since early 2026 I have worked on Agentic Workflow enablement across Cypress products — shipping Agent Skills, LLM optimized documentation, an MCP server and CLI for customer data access, and agentic hooks in the Cypress test runner so agents can drive tests, triage failures, and generate new ones. I build production LLM integrations with pragmatic guardrails: prompt design, tracing, evaluation, and observability (Langfuse), across providers including Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex. Back End Development: Node.js services, GraphQL APIs, and data at scale My current focus is Node.js — Express and Next.js API layers — with GraphQL and REST, backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and ClickHouse for analytics heavy workloads. At Cypress I built UI Coverage: ingesting full DOM snapshots from every test moment, analyzing interactive elements, and surfacing coverage gaps. That stack included Puppeteer, ClickHouse, and AWS (SQS, ECS, Lambda, S3). Earlier in my career I was an enterprise Java developer (Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, Kafka) on defense and financial systems at Lockheed Martin, TD Ameritrade, and Chewy. Node.js GraphQL PostgreSQL ClickHouse
Front End Development: TypeScript, React, Vue, and Next.js with modern CSS A lot of my work is React and Vue in TypeScript — component architecture, state management, routing, and performance. I ship production UIs with Next.js, Tailwind, and semantic HTML/CSS, and I am comfortable across SPA, SSR, and static site generation (Gatsby, Next.js). Representative work: Mutual of Omaha — rewrite of main customer service portal (React) Chewy.com — Checkout (Vue) and Shopping Cart (React) rewrites WoodmenLife — marketing site migration to React, Contentful, and Gatsby SSG TD Ameritrade — internal Order Management UI (Angular) US Air Force — greenfield Weather Forecast generator UI (React) Cypress.io — Component Testing, UI Coverage, and Studio AI surfaces React Next.js Vue.js Tailwind CSS
Testing: Cypress, Playwright, and AI-assisted test automation As Lead Engineer at Cypress.io, I have shipped Component Testing, UI Coverage, Studio AI test generation, and agentic test workflows. I have deep expertise in end to end and component testing — flakiness reduction, CI integration, coverage analysis, and using LLMs to accelerate authoring and triage. Jest Vitest Cypress Playwright
Tools & Observability: AWS, CI/CD, and production monitoring I work across the modern delivery stack: Git (GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), Jira/ADO issue tracking, and Jenkins or ADO pipelines for CI/CD. For production systems I rely on observability tooling — Honeycomb for distributed tracing and Sentry for error monitoring — to keep quality high as features ship quickly. Git Honeycomb Sentry AWS
